benchmark.schemaSql: CREATE TABLE customers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, ordered_at TEXT NOT NULL, total INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer_timeline ON orders(customer_id, ordered_at DESC, id DESC);

title: [パフォーマンスチューニング][書いてみよう] 直近データを1回で取り出す
statement:
customers と orders から、顧客ごとの直近注文を1回のクエリで取得してください。表示する列は customer_name, latest_ordered_at, latest_total。注文がない顧客は除き、customer_name の昇順で並べます。

ROW_NUMBER() で顧客ごとに注文を新しい順に並べ、1件目だけを残します。

constraints.name: 直近判定
constraints.value: ordered_at の降順、同日の場合は orders.id の降順で直近を決めます

constraints.name: N+1回避
constraints.value: 顧客ごとの個別検索ではなく、ウィンドウ関数でまとめて求めます

starterSql:
WITH ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    ordered_at,
    total,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id
      ORDER BY ordered_at DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM orders
)
SELECT
  customers.name AS customer_name,
  ranked_orders.ordered_at AS latest_ordered_at,
  ranked_orders.total AS latest_total
FROM customers
JOIN ranked_orders
  ON ranked_orders.customer_id = customers.id
-- 直近の1件だけにします
ORDER BY customers.name ASC;
solutionSql:
WITH ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    ordered_at,
    total,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id
      ORDER BY ordered_at DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM orders
)
SELECT
  customers.name AS customer_name,
  ranked_orders.ordered_at AS latest_ordered_at,
  ranked_orders.total AS latest_total
FROM customers
JOIN ranked_orders
  ON ranked_orders.customer_id = customers.id
WHERE ranked_orders.rn = 1
ORDER BY customers.name ASC;

tests.name: 同日はidが大きい注文を直近にする
